label: Bible Study
prompt: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for _____, and things wherewith one may edify another.
verse: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
note: Pursue what makes for peace — and what builds each other up.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And said, O man greatly _____, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.
verse: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.
note: A heavenly visitor touches trembling Daniel: O man greatly beloved, fear not — be strong, yea, be strong.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the LORD: and he brought the _____ ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.
verse: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the LORD: and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.
note: Hezekiah's sign of healing: the shadow went backward ten degrees on the dial of Ahaz.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made _____.
verse: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
note: Paul's two-Adams theology in one verse: one man brought death to all, the Second brings life.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an _____.
verse: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.
note: Paul's blunt family-finance rule: whoever won't provide for his own household is 'worse than an infidel.'
